tokens.name: oak
tokens.usage: Primary brand color and the logo's dark green. About 25–30% of a layout: hero sections, headers, primary buttons on light grounds, photo frames. Cream text on oak 9.6:1; gold on oak 5.4:1.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Secondary green and the logo tree's mid-green. 3% or less: small signals only, such as checkmarks, status badges and 'most booked' tags. Never a large field. Cream text on leaf 4.9:1.

tokens.name: brown
tokens.usage: Warm contrast, about 5%. Use as type and thin lines on cream or paper: section headlines (10.0:1 on cream), text links, dividers, testimonials. Never a large fill, and never on or under charcoal or oak.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Dark neutral, about 10%. Default body text on cream (12.8:1) and paper (14.7:1); thin dark bands such as trust strips, footers and sticky call bars. Never the dominant background.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Background canvas, about 45–50% of a layout. Also the text color on oak, charcoal and leaf.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and form fields sitting on a cream background, about 5–10% of a layout. One step lighter than cream so boxes read as separate without borders or shadows; never a section background or used alone. Charcoal, brown and oak text all pass on it (11:1 or more).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Accent, 3% or less, on dark grounds only: primary call buttons on oak or charcoal (charcoal text, 7.1:1), short rules, eyebrow labels. Too light for anything on cream (1.8:1); use brown or oak for accents there.

styles.name: headline-hero
styles.sample: Property maintenance for those who take pride in their home.
styles.usage: Website hero headline only. Cream over a darkened photo or oak. 42px on phones.

styles.name: headline-xl
styles.sample: Property maintenance for those who take pride in their home.
styles.usage: Hero headlines. Brown on cream, cream on oak.

styles.name: headline-md
styles.usage: Sub-sections, mobile section headlines, flyer headlines.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on cards and flyers. Oak on cream or paper, gold or cream on oak.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: They show up when they say they will.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Short labels above headlines, set in capitals. Keep tracking tight.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Lawn, fall cleanup, snow, and landscaping from one dependable crew.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every service is quoted up front, scheduled in advance, and done by the same crew you met on day one.
styles.usage: Default body copy. Never smaller than 16px on the web.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Two visits, leaf removal, bed cleanup, and haul-away.
